name: present_chat_component
description: Show the user a panel in the chat, after your message. choice and form panels need a title naming their topic (for example "For Bob"); keep titles distinct across panels. choice: clickable options (data {prompt, options:[{label}]}, 1-8 one-line labels); a click sends "<title>: <label>" as the user's message. form: fields the user fills and submits as one message starting with the title (data {prompt, fields:[{name,label,type:text|email|number|select|multi,required,options}]}); multi is a checkbox group of 1-8 one-line options, sent as "<title>: A, C". Answered panels stay in the chat, read-only. status and todo_list are display only. Reuse component_id with the latest revision to update a panel, including after a refused call; dismiss:true closes one you replace. Panels never authorize actions
